scope: exploratory after original mixed effects known; no AMP refitting
development_resampling: sample original selection global groups jointly across all five development sources, retain multiplicities and re-normalize source weights; preserve original selection/validation partition
held_resampling: independent uniform held-source group bootstrap, shared models and methods within fold
reference: fixed original model-specific inventory; no development-distance feature in primary contrast
refit: weighted scaling, intercept, slopes re-estimated in every development draw; ridge 0.01 fixed
invalid: empty development source or failed fit undefined; no replacement; report counts
CI: pointwise95 percentile; valid>=95%; nondegenerate; G>=5; unadjusted; includes development record sampling plus held record sampling, excludes new-source and training-weight uncertainty
secondary: fixed-held composition across refits; compare original conditional intervals; first1000 versus all2000 quantile stability; do not choose B by favorable conclusion
